SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME , TARGET AS TARGET , KEY_1 AS KEY_1 , KEY_2 AS KEY_2 FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' AND ROWNUM < 51 ORDER BY DOC_NAME, KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'SMT1' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , PLANT_ID AS PLANT , KEY_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO , ITEM_NO AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , DECODE(STATUS,'P','C','E','D',STATUS) AS STATUS , ITEM_CODE AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , QUANTITY AS ITEM_QTY , QUANTITY_UNIT AS UNIT_MEASURE , UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE , AMOUNT AS ITEM_AMT , TO_CHAR(ISSUE_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE , CUSTOMER_SHIP_TO_ID AS PURCHASER_USER_ID , TO_CHAR(REQUEST_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS RD_DATE , PR_NO AS LEGACY_PR_NO , PLANT_ID AS DELY_TO_LOCATION , CUSTOMER_SHIP_TO_ADDRESS AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT , CUSTOMER_SHIP_TO_NAME AS REQ_USER_NAME , ORGANIZATION_NAME AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , ITEM_DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION , ITEM_SPEC||'^'||ITEM_CHAR AS SPECIFICATION , SUPPLIER_CODE AS SELLER , AMOUNT_UNIT||'^'||WORK_TYPE||'^'||PURCHASE_PERSON||'^'||CUSTOMER_SHIP_TO_TEL AS IV_COLUMN FROM V_STEPS_PO WHERE PLANT_ID = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_NO = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND ITEM_NO = $G_RS.KEY_2$ ORDER BY PLANT_ID, KEY_NO, ITEM_NO
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET KEY_6 = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') , IF_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET KEY_6 = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') , IF_FLAG = 'E' WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
